defects.description: Section header was not translated into Russian.
Unnatural word choice for 'emit event' in a technical context; 'генерировать' or 'отправлять' is preferred, especially as 'генерируется' is used later in the same text.
Incorrect case/grammar; the term 'Фаза' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('фазы') to modify 'переход'.
Incorrect case/grammar; the term 'Роль' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('роли') to modify 'присутствия'.
Incorrect case/grammar; the term 'Эскалация' is used in the nominative case instead of the genitive ('эскалации') to modify 'целостности'.
